Centronuclear skeletal myopathy; dilated cardiomyopathy in 2/3 patients. Respiratory weakness does not establish intrinsic lung damage.

Yersinia infection of mesenteric lymph nodes; mesenteric location alone does not establish intestinal damage.

Developmental leukoencephalopathy with neurologic regression, spasticity and movement disorders; gastrointestinal and urinary findings occur in 1/9.
Ovarian endocrine failure and skeletal abnormalities define Turner syndrome; hearing loss and specific learning disability each 30-79%. Thyroiditis and steatosis are separate diseases.
Inherited postsynaptic neuromuscular junction dysfunction; ophthalmoplegia and weakness reflect impaired neuromuscular transmission.
Congenital phalangeal hypoplasia defines brachydactyly; speech/language developmental delay reported in 1/2 patients, with limited evidence from a small sample.
Molybdenum cofactor metabolic deficiency with defining destructive encephalopathy; supplied data do not establish lens dislocation in at least 30%.
Autoimmune blistering of skin defines this umbrella; damaging mucosal involvement is not established in most patients across its subtypes.
Autoimmune inflammation of the ocular uvea; the erroneous ear/nose/throat parent does not establish additional organ involvement.
Supplied HPO: pericarditis 80-99%, arthritis and pleuritis 30-79%; intestinal obstruction omitted by cap. Episodic rash and conjunctival redness do not establish damage.
Nonsyndromic inherited sensorineural hearing loss.
Neurodevelopmental syndrome with developmental delay, intellectual disability and brain malformation; constipation and feeding difficulty alone do not establish gastrointestinal damage.
Bacteria-associated macrophage granulomatous disease, usually urinary; skin inflammation and ulcers 80-99% in supplied HPO. Bowel symptoms alone do not establish damage.
Inherited intestinal methionine transport/metabolic disorder; intellectual disability and seizures characterize most reported cases. Aminoaciduria alone is not renal damage.
Glycerol metabolism defect; neurologic impairment and muscular dystrophy chiefly concern complex Xp21 deletions and are not established across most of this umbrella.
Hydrocephalus and skeletal malformations define syndrome; airway malformations 57-76%, microphthalmia 49/56. Cardiac malformations omitted by four-axis cap.
Corpus callosum agenesis and macrocephaly define the syndrome, with common intellectual disability and Chiari malformation; facial shape alone adds no axis.
Postsurgical loss of endocrine pancreatic insulin production defines this condition.
Inherited dystroglycan O-glycosylation disorder defined by congenital muscular dystrophy and intellectual disability; ocular findings lack a supported frequency of at least 30%.
Osteosclerotic skeletal dysplasia; enamel/dental abnormalities 80-99%, tooth agenesis 30-79%. Cerebral calcification and proptosis do not establish functional damage.
Inherited retinal rod-cone degeneration with visual field loss and retinal pigment epithelial atrophy.
